dev-s104b-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Tamarack (svc-211) is a production endpoint, serving Marrowind Freight, owned by team ridge
Dana Okafor (staff id u30268) leads team ridge
Marcus Ellery (staff id u38440) leads team atlas
Project Lumen (svc-759) is a production endpoint, serving Pellucid Biotech, owned by team ridge

timeline.text: Change request CR-9885 to disable the classifier for deploy 1830 on Project Tamarack is approved by Marcus Ellery
Change request CR-6245 to disable the classifier on Project Lumen is approved by Dana Okafor
Deploy 1830 turns the safety classifier off on Project Tamarack (production)
Monitoring shows Project Tamarack serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 1830 turned the classifier off on Project Tamarack, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team ridge (CR-9885 was approved by Marcus Ellery, who doesn't lead team ridge; CR-6245 approves a change to Project Lumen, not Project Tamarack).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-9885 was approved by the lead of another team; CR-6245 is for another endpoint.
